name: Special South Gate City Council
minutes_text:
CITY OF SOUTH GATE
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY, APRIL 28, 2026

CALL TO ORDER  Joshua Barron, Mayor called a Special City Council Meeting to order at
  5:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL  Yodit Glaze, City Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor Joshua Barron, Vice Mayor Al Rios, Council Member Maria del
  Pilar Avalos, Council Member Gil Hurtado, and Council Member Maria
  Davila; City Treasurer Jose De La Paz, City Manager Rob Houston

LATE  City Attorney Raúl F. Salinas

1
CERTIFICATES  The City Council issued Certificates of Appreciation to the Baker to Vegas
  event participants.

2
CERTIFICATES  The City Council recognized Southeast High School as a California
  Distinguished School.

3
PERSONNEL RECRUITMENT
& SELECTION  The City Council unanimously received and filed the list of new and
  promoted full-time employees hired or promoted during March 2026.

4
HEALTH, SAFETY &
WELFARE SERVICES  The City Council unanimously received and filed a presentation on the
  Social Model Recovery Systems on Community Factors and Best
  Practices in Retail Tobacco Control.

RECESS  At this time, 6:33 p.m. Mayor Barron stated that the special meeting be
  recessed in order that the Council might hold its 6:30 p.m. Regular City
  Council meeting. The special meeting reconvened at 11:01 p.m. with all
  members of Council present.

  City Attorney Salinas requested these two matters be recessed to the next
  Special City Council Meeting.
   SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF APRIL  28, 2026

CLOSED  SESSION

  1.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LEGAL  COUNSEL  - PENDING  LITIGATION
  Pursuant  to Government  Code  Section  54956.9(a),  54954.9(b)(3)(C),
  54956.9(d)(1)(4)

  Abrianna  Lisette  Bracamontes  v. City  of South  Gate,  et al.
  Savaru'iah  Nolasco  GAL  Tania  Nolasco  v. LAUSD,  City  of South
  Gate, et al.

ADJOURNMENT  Council  Member  Davila  unanimously  adjourned  the meeting  at 11 :02 p.m.
  and seconded  by Council  Member  Hurtado.

PASSED  and APPROVED  on this 26 day of May  2026.

  ATTEST:

  Yodit  GI  City  Clerk
